title: maxboels/TrackingPanTiltCam — Production-Ready YOLOv8 Turret Codebase for Splash Adaptation
context: Splash needs computer vision tracking with auto-aim for person targeting. The maxboels/TrackingPanTiltCam project provides a complete, tested implementation.
what_was_found: This GitHub repo implements YOLOv8 person detection with Kalman filtering, PCA9685 servo control (16-channel I2C), motion compensation to prevent feedback loops, and TWO tracking modes: Surveillance (smooth, keep in frame) and Turret (precision center-of-bounding-box aiming). Turret mode uses shorter history (3 positions), exponential weighting, responsive Kalman. Motion compensation distinguishes real target motion from camera-induced apparent motion.
key_features: Turret mode — exactly what Splash needs for auto-aim at center of bounding box
Kalman filtering — predicts positions during occlusions, reduces jitter
Motion compensation — prevents feedback loops when camera moves
PCA9685 — same controller planned for Splash
Performance logging + evaluation system — crucial for Splash testing
source: Hour 7 Competitor Analysis — GitHub maxboels/TrackingPanTiltCam direct fetch
action: Clone repo and study turret mode adaptation. Key files: main.py, src/tracking/, config/config.json. Adapt PCA9685 bridge for Splash's ESP32 instead of Arduino.
